gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on QNAP's own US store today the TS-464-8G plus the cheapest Seagate IronWolf pair it sells (2× 4 TB at $219 each) comes to $1,077. That means none of ChatGPT's three picks fits a $1,000 budget that includes drives. TerraMaster's store has the F4-425 Plus at $539.99, which comes to $977.99 with the same two drives.
standout_why: I read the pages ChatGPT cited. ComputingForGeeks prices the enclosures only: DS925+ about $760 and TS-464 about $640 on Amazon, Oct 1 2026. It says drives are excluded and gives no total. nas.kuibu.net lists TS-464 '~$639' and DXP4800 Plus '$619-699' with no dates and no totals with drives. It names the F4-425 Plus/Pro without prices. Neither page prices the TerraMaster F4-425 line or the UGREEN DXP4800 GT/Pro, and neither does the sum with drives. ChatGPT asks 'Does the $1,000 include hard drives?' in all seven chats. Its only answer is a vague '$600 enclosure can easily become $1,000–$1,200'.
decides: If the $1,000 is for the enclosure only, Synology DS925+ stays the pick for software, and every one of ChatGPT's picks fits. If the $1,000 includes drives, the dated store prices settle it. TS-464-8G with two drives is $1,077 and DXP4800 Plus is $1,057.99, both over budget. A DS925+ at about $760 would be about $1,198. Under $1,000 you get the TerraMaster F4-425 Plus ($977.99), the F4-425 ($867.99) or the UGREEN DXP4800 GT ($997.99). The page should lead with the two-budget split and these totals.
